start: A member with some MettleUp workouts and a Strong 6 export (semicolon file, 'Weight (kg)')

user_sees: Page titled 'Import from Strong'
Button 'Choose Strong file'
'After your workouts come in, we build your routines from the workouts you repeat most.'
must_not: The Hevy wording on the Strong page

user_sees: Preview: 'Workouts', 'Sets', 'Exercises', 'Already in MettleUp', 'Date range'
Merge picked by default because the member has own workouts
must_not: Replace picked by default over real workouts
Rest-timer rows counted as sets

steps.action: Keep 'Merge' and tap the import button
user_sees: Result: 'Workouts added', 'Sets logged', 'New exercises created', 'Logged in MettleUp too (skipped)'
'Undo import'
must_not: A workout the member also logged in MettleUp added twice
Warm-ups counted as working sets

user_sees: 'We built N routines from the workouts you repeat most.'
must_not: Routines made from one-off workouts

start: Welcome screen of a fresh install

steps.action: On 'Coming from Hevy or Strong?' tap 'From Strong'
user_sees: 'Your Strong workouts and routines come in right after you tap Start training.'
must_not: The import opening before the member is in

user_sees: The Workout tab opens the Strong import once
must_not: The Hevy import opening
The import opening again on every visit

start: An older Strong file (comma-separated, no units in the column names, dates that read two ways)

user_sees: 'This file does not say its units. Pick the one Strong showed you.'
'Kilograms and km' and 'Pounds and miles' with none picked
Button reads 'Choose kg or lb first' and is off
must_not: A unit picked for the member
The import allowed before the unit is chosen

user_sees: 'This file writes dates as numbers only, and they can be read two ways.' with Day-first and Month-first choices
must_not: Dates read month-first without asking
Workouts landing on wrong days

user_sees: Weights stored exactly as pounds turned into kg
must_not: 135 lb stored rounded, so it reads as a new record later

steps.action: Pick a file that is not a Strong export
user_sees: 'That doesn’t look like a Strong export (unexpected columns).'
must_not: Any workout written
A crash

user_sees: 'That file has no rows to import.'
must_not: A success screen with 0 workouts

steps.action: Pick a file whose dates Excel rewrote
user_sees: 'The dates in its Date column could not be read (for example ...). Export the file from Strong again and pick it without opening it in Excel.'
Or 'Rows left out (date unreadable)' with a count
must_not: Rows with unreadable dates dropped with no word

start: A member with 12 workouts in MettleUp, on the preview

user_sees: 'Delete all 12 of your workouts in MettleUp, then import. You can undo right after.'
must_not: Replace deleting without naming how many

user_sees: The 12 workouts back, the imported ones gone
must_not: Imported workouts left behind
Own workouts lost after Undo

steps.action: Run the same file again with 'Merge'
user_sees: 'Already imported (skipped)' with the count
must_not: The same workouts added twice

start: Welcome or Workout tab card 'Coming from Hevy or Strong?'

steps.action: Read the card while not signed in
user_sees: 'Bring your workouts, records and routines with you. Everything stays on this phone.'
must_not: 'Everything stays on this phone.' shown to a signed-in member

steps.action: Sign in, import, look at the account
user_sees: The imported workouts copied to the member's account
must_not: Imported workouts sent anywhere but the member's own account
The gym seeing them without the member's share switch
